2608.08627.title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
2608.08627.paper_summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank. We study a deployment problem: convert that checkpoint to a smaller standard MoE under an explicit expert budget, without adding a compression-specific online module. To address this, we introduce UniMoMo, a post-training compression framework formulated as a constrained graph coarsening problem. Rather than relying on parameter distance, UniMoMo groups experts based on their functional similarity, using an unlabeled calibration set to measure how similarly experts respond to shared recommendation states. To prevent performance degradation, we introduce a layer-adaptive protection mechanism that restricts the merging of high-traffic experts based on their routing exposure. Across Amazon Beauty, KuaiRec, and TenRec with 2, 4, and 6 MoE blocks, the final four-expert checkpoints obtain source-relative five-run mean NDCG@10 ratios of 99.92%--102.30% and measured A100 speedups of 1.28$\times$--1.63$\times$. An aggressive two-expert, top-1 operating point obtains ratios of 98.36%--104.24% and speedups of 1.47$\times$--2.21$\times$. These endpoint results evaluate the complete conversion-and-adaptation workflow and show that a trained recommendation MoE can be exported at multiple serving budgets.
2608.08627.paper_summary_zh: 稀疏專家混合（MoE）層通過條件計算擴展了推薦能力，但訓練後的檢查點仍然存儲並路由其完整的專家庫。我們研究了一個部署問題：在明確的專家預算下，將該檢查點轉換為一個較小的標準 MoE，而不添加特定於壓縮的在線模塊。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了 UniMoMo，一個後訓練壓縮框架，該框架被表述為一個受限的圖粗化問題。UniMoMo 不依賴於參數距離，而是根據專家的功能相似性對專家進行分組，使用未標記的校準集來測量專家對共享推薦狀態的響應相似性。為了防止性能下降，我們引入了一種層自適應保護機制，根據專家的路由暴露限制高流量專家的合併。在 Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec 和 TenRec 上，使用 2、4 和 6 個 MoE 模塊，最終的四專家檢查點獲得了相對於來源的五次運行平均 NDCG@10 比率為 99.92%--102.30%，並測得 A100 加速比為 1.28$\times$--1.63$\times$。一個激進的兩專家、top-1 操作點獲得了 98.36%--104.24% 的比率和 1.47$\times$--2.21$\times$ 的加速比。這些端點結果評估了完整的轉換和適應工作流程，並顯示訓練過的推薦 MoE 可以在多個服務預算下導出。
